title: Vow and Harbor
author: Wendell Hartwell
blurb: Xanthe Thornbury, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
